blank_module.name: Blank Module
blank_module.shortDescription: A blank module. With the right machine, this could rewrite this into something useful.

system_module_ruined.name: Ruined Module
system_module_ruined.shortDescription: A completely ruined module. Still holds some value as salvage. Can be broken down with a Screwdriver.

system_module_corrupt.name: Corrupted Module
system_module_corrupt.shortDescription: A corrupted module. Can be restored with Electronic parts... and a little know-how.

farm_module_nutrifruit.name: Nutrifruit Hydroponic Module
farm_module_nutrifruit.shortDescription: A module by pastel that allow Hydroponic System to yield more Nutrifruit when farming them. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

farm_module_dream_cap.name: Dream Cap Neutralizer Hydroponic Module
farm_module_dream_cap.shortDescription: A module that neutralize all psychoactive propreties of Dream Cap when farming them, turning them into Meal Cap. This module's unique effect can be stacked but doesn't affect other plants.

farm_module_kotton_loom.name: Kotton Auto Loom Hydroponic Module
farm_module_kotton_loom.shortDescription: A module that wove the Kotton Fiber into a fabric when farming them. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

farm_module_nightmare_cap.name: Dream Cap Nightmare Hydroponic Module
farm_module_nightmare_cap.shortDescription: A module that concentrate psychoactive propreties of Dream Cap when farming them, turning them into Nightmare Cap, a toxic variant. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

farm_module_fillerweed_production.name: Fillerweed Production Hydroponic Module
farm_module_fillerweed_production.shortDescription: A module will improve yield of Fillerweed at the cost of losing seeds. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants. This effect is not stackable

farm_module_hydroreed_filter.name: Hydroreed Filter Hydroponic Module
farm_module_hydroreed_filter.shortDescription: A Module that allows the stem of a grown Hydroreed to be harvested and used as a water filter. Does not affect other plants.

farm_module_smuggler.name: Hydroponic Smuggler Module
farm_module_smuggler.shortDescription: A module that remove the contrabands status of any growing seeds.

dna_manipulator_module_stabilizer.name: Genetic Stabilizer Module
dna_manipulator_module_stabilizer.shortDescription: Lets the target survive DNA extraction: a trait can be removed without destroying the target.

dna_manipulator_module_positive_filter.name: Positive Trait Filter Module
dna_manipulator_module_positive_filter.shortDescription: Restricts DNA extraction to positive traits. Nothing is extracted from a target that has none.

dna_manipulator_module_negative_filter.name: Negative Trait Filter Module
dna_manipulator_module_negative_filter.shortDescription: Restricts DNA extraction to negative traits. Nothing is extracted from a target that has none.

dna_manipulator_module_precision.name: Precision Extraction Module
dna_manipulator_module_precision.shortDescription: Use this module on a DNA Data Disk containing a trait to scan it. When installed in a DNA Manipulator, it will only extract the scanned trait.

printer_module_metal.name: Metal Printer Module
printer_module_metal.shortDescription: A module that allows the printer to use metal printer chips.

system_uncapped_neural_core.name: Neural Core Module (Uncapped)
system_uncapped_neural_core.shortDescription: High-performance, but unstable, and illegal. An AI core housed inside a system module. These type of AI core have a tendency to go rogue.

alarm_module_transmitter.name: Alarm Transmitter Module
alarm_module_transmitter.shortDescription: Currently Transmitting To: Security Transmitting twice to the same faction has no additional effect.
alarm_module_transmitter.flavorText: This module will transmit security camera footage captured by your cameras to the set faction.

furnace_module_blast.name: Furnace Module (Blast)
furnace_module_blast.shortDescription: A special Module that modifies the Furnace, allowing 3 Materials to create 2 Metal Ingots (at slightly lower purity). Does not stack.

furnace_module_junk.name: Furnace Module (Junk Processing)
furnace_module_junk.shortDescription: A special Module that modifies the Furnace, allowing Junk to be processed into Scrap Metal.

system_capped_neural_core.name: Neural Core Module (Capped)
system_capped_neural_core.shortDescription: AI Cores are illegal onboard the Station. This unit features integrated safeguards that curb rogue behavior, while throttling its performance.

crypto_module_sec.name: Cryptographic Desequencer Chip (Security)
crypto_module_sec.shortDescription: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Security permissions to Blank Keycards.

printer_module_melee_batch.shortDescription: A printer module that adds one more weapon to every melee weapon print. Slow and power hungry.

module_extractor.name: Module Extractor (Basic)
module_extractor.shortDescription: Allows you to extract stuck modules from machines without breaking them. Has 6 uses. Can be partially refurbished with Electronic Parts.

module_extractor_advanced.name: Module Extractor (Advanced)
module_extractor_advanced.shortDescription: Allows you to extract stuck modules from machines without breaking them. This advanced model will not degrade with use.

module_bay_expansion_kit.name: Module Bay Expansion Kit
module_bay_expansion_kit.shortDescription: A one time use kit that will allow you to expand Machine's Module capacity. This kit is not compatible with Chemical or other special Machines.

chem_module.name: Chemical Equipment Module
chem_module.shortDescription: Require a module extractor to remove once installed. A special module that can improve the Blender, the Heating Plate and the Chem Finisher

node_small.name: Node (Small)
node_small.shortDescription: A specialized circuit that can provide or receive bonuses from adjacent Modules when installed in certain Machines.
